name: smwmusic-the-legend-of-zelda-link-s-awakening-cave
title: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening - Cave
description:
This is a port I made of the cave theme from The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening. This is NOT to be confused with the dungeon cave theme, this is the one you hear in caves on the main overworld.



This is my very first completed port, so it's probably not the best, but I am planning on making more ports soon, so hopefully I will slowly get better as time goes on.
